offering_description.value: Investment management firm that runs affiliated boutique investment strategies across equities, fixed income and multi-asset portfolios. It sells these strategies to institutions, intermediaries and individual investors, earning fees on assets managed.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; separate account strategies; closed-end and private fund vehicles

primary_services.value: investment management; sub-advisory services; investment research

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors, wealth managers, financial advisers, intermediaries; B2C: individual investors and high-net-worth clients through funds and separate accounts; B2G: public pension plans and government retirement funds

end_markets.value: asset management; retirement and pension savings; wealth management; endowments and foundations

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees on assets under management, plus performance fees on some strategies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages client portfolios for fees, sold to institutions, intermediaries and individual investors

geography_served.value: global: clients across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: several affiliated investment boutiques offering equity, credit and multi-asset strategies to shared client types

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales teams selling to pensions, endowments and foundations; distributors / dealers: mutual fund distributors and broker-dealers selling fund shares; partners / resellers: wealth managers, financial advisers and sub-advisory platforms
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and fund manager under SEC rules and foreign financial regulators
